capabilities: Chat with AI agents in group Channels and direct messages
Create reusable subagent role prompts with chosen models and tools
Save, browse and edit agent memory records across chats
Schedule recurring or file-triggered agent Events
Connect LLM providers, local model servers and MCP servers
extras: Currently in alpha; requires Obsidian desktop 1.11.4+ and a separate runtime install; Windows x64 is primary, macOS and Linux experimental, mobile unsupported. Core harness is free with model costs paid to providers; support via Patreon. Notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to work with AI agents that can read and edit notes, run tools, remember context across chats, or work on a schedule.
